description: Caption a known template with text you provide. Use when you already know which template you want. Cheaper and faster than meme_generate. Costs 1 credit.

captions.description: One or more captions with their positions.

template_id.description: Template ID, e.g. "tpl_drake". Use createa_template_search to find one.

watermark.description: Optional brand watermark (Starter+ plans only). Provide either "text" OR "logo_url". Defaults: bottom-right, 65% opacity, white-on-dark text legible on any background.

logo_url.description: Public URL of a logo image to stamp instead of text.

scale.description: Logo width as a fraction of image width (logo mode).

name: createa_meme_caption
